en: There are recently-constructed huts dotting this coastal trail. There aren't signs of recent usage, however, so whoever built them has probably moved on.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old rest stop has a sizeable outdoor eating area. In its day, it was probably a very popular place to get a meal.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a hobbled-together cabin nestled into the base of the cliff here. It's quite conspicuous.
ctx: world map location description

en: Hardly anything remains of this old cabin but for a few rotting boards and beams.
ctx: world map location description

en: The entrance to this place is well-disguised, and the interior seems clean and well-kept.
ctx: world map location description

en: Somebody went to great lengths to excavate this tunnel and put a vault here. Somebody else evidently went to great lengths to break into it.
ctx: world map location description

en: This ziggurat climbs high above the treeline, but age and neglect have brought much of it down upon itself.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a well-tended tunnel leading into the mountainside here. It has several heavy barricades blocking it.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is nothing particularly remarkable about this clearing. It might be a good place to rest up.
ctx: world map location description

en: This collapsed home appears unremarkable at first, but it looks as though there has been recent traffic to and from the basement.
ctx: world map location description

en: This building is in excellent condition. Based on the remaining signage, it was once some kind of high-end marketplace. Perhaps something of use remains inside.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old sewer junction that might provide a way across the water. It hasn't been in active use for many years, so at least you are unlikely to find much in the way of actual sewage.
ctx: world map location description

en: Just one more run-down home along a run-down road. At the very least it might provide acceptable shelter for a night.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small building decorated with macabre carvings juts out of the earth here like an angry fang. There is no obvious way inside.
ctx: world map location description

en: This opulent palace is sorely out of place against the bleak swath of ruin that surrounds it. This Frico must like to make an impression.
ctx: world map location description

en: This forest trail is blocked by some kind of crude wooden fortress. It should be simple enough to get inside of it, but there is a perplexing odour coming from behind the walls.
ctx: world map location description

en: Crumbling remnants of a town on the sea. Many of the buildings are holding up well enough, and there are footprints indicating recent traffic, but they are not the footprints of orcs or men.
ctx: world map location description

en: A foul, wet air clings to this old sewer tunnel, but with any luck, you'll find a useable passage to the other side.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a small building here housing what appears to be a sewer access. There's no way to know just what this connects to.
ctx: world map location description

en: It looks as if this tunnel connects to a small building up above.
ctx: world map location description

en: This forest path is twisted and confusing, and there are no obvious landmarks to follow. Navigating it without some idea of where you're headed promises to be fruitless.
ctx: world map location description

en: Ash and glittering shards of obsidian litter this twisted trail through the Blackglass mountains. Visibility is highly limited.
ctx: world map location description

en: This building likely once served as an inspection area for merchants carrying goods along the road. Now, it stands unused, except perhaps as a shelter for occasional travellers.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old mansion is relatively sheltered by the surrounding terrain, and has escaped much damage. Perhaps it has escaped the notice of looters as well.
ctx: world map location description

en: This timber fortress appears to have been erected relatively recently. It isn't a perfect shelter against the elements, but it might be acceptable in a pinch.
ctx: world map location description

en: This road winds steeply down the side of the mountain, diving into the forest below.
ctx: world map location description

en: This cave appears to once have been used to house a great deal of people. It might be a good place to hide out.
ctx: world map location description

en: At first, this building appears to be all but totally demolished, but recent traffic indicates that someone, or something, is still using the basement.
ctx: world map location description

en: This broad cavern has an air of animal stink about it, but it might make a decent shelter if you cleared it out.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small hut sits here amid the dampness of the swamp. It might make an acceptable place to camp for a while, if you could tolerate the moisture and the insects.
ctx: world map location description

en: The road here ends abruptly at a stony promontory. Perhaps there was once a structure here, or else a landing for small boats.
ctx: world map location description

en: This weathered lighthouse stands defiant against the grey sky. It has been beaten by many long years of neglect, but it still appears to be sturdy.
ctx: world map location description

en: This was the cave you washed up in. There's no reason to go back inside that watery deathtrap.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old farm looks like it might have once been used to corral animals, and there are hints that it might still see occasional use as a shelter.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old mine appears to have been converted into a town of sorts, but it's unclear as to whether anyone is still here.
ctx: world map location description

en: This serene abbey is understated, a classic sign of orcish design. It's small, and looks like it would have been a charming place to have a wedding, back when such things were still practiced on the island.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old hunting lodge that was once a favorite retreat of someone named Maxim Spartill, if the signage is to be believed.
ctx: world map location description

en: A private archive bearing stately and official ornamentation. It looks as though all of the windows have been plastered over, and a dark air hangs heavy over the building.
ctx: world map location description

en: The portal that carried you to Lord Barrod's castle is now closed, the trip unnervingly fresh in your mind. You can almost still feel his eyes boring through you.
ctx: world map location description

en: This appears to be an ancient cemetary. It is small and unremarkable.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old village appears to be entirely empty. There aren't even signs of animal habitation.
ctx: world map location description

en: The marble halls of this exquisite tomb are alive with a tense energy. Something tremendous lurks within.
ctx: world map location description

en: This sheltered clearing still holds the remains of some kind of ceremonial gathering.
ctx: world map location description

en: This might once have been a town, but ramshackle walls have been erected in strange places. Still, perhaps there is shelter to be found.
ctx: world map location description

en: Even before you see the carnage, you can smell it. Mangled bits of corpsemeat litter the clearing. Whoever it was isn't just dead, they are utterly destroyed.
ctx: world map location description

en: This appears to be a conveniently-located rest stop for merchants passing through the mountain trail.
ctx: world map location description

en: The mood about this small congregation is eerie and a little too enthusiastic.
ctx: world map location description

en: This underground sprawl is a mess of sloppily-erected walls and confusing passages, cluttered with rubble and permeated with a nauseating odour.
ctx: world map location description

en: This looks like a network of tunnels between nearby basement constructions. It might still be navigable.
ctx: world map location description

en: A large, yawning cavern with multiple exits. It's too large for your light to cover easily, so you can't tell if there's anything inside or not.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a broad clearing in the marsh vegetation here. It might be an acceptable place to camp, and it is large enough to accomodate a whole group.
ctx: world map location description

en: A watchtower juts above the treetops here. It might still be sturdy enough to get a good view of the surrounding terrain.
ctx: world map location description

en: Tightly-clustered buildings and wooden barricades form a twisted path here. There's no telling what could be lurking behind any particular corner.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small, overgrown graveyard, nearly swallowed up by the encroaching wilderness.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old home, sheltered by a tall copse of trees.
ctx: world map location description

en: Perhaps this was once a popular place for travelers to enjoy a night's shelter. Weather, age, and encroaching woodland have destroyed most of it.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is an old stone bridge still spanning a narrow stretch of the river here. It still appears to be sturdy, despite a collapsed building of similar construction nearby.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small, unassuming home that appears to still be intact. Would make a decent shelter for the night.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is some kind of shrine or memorial at the centre of a crossroads here. It looks long-neglected, but still serves as a prominent landmark.
ctx: world map location description

en: A rough fortress hacked together out of sloppy lumber. It promises to guard against beasts and intruders, if not against the elements.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old brick house tucked away in a forgotten corner of the forest. Perhaps once it lay along a road, now long overgrown.
ctx: world map location description

en: This wide plateau is all that's left of what might once have been a town or a trading post, but there is very little rubble remaining, as if the buildings were leveled deliberately.
ctx: world map location description

en: A pass running through a narrow valley. There appear to be multiple routes, and the area is ripe for an ambush.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old town has nearly been swallowed by swelling tides. There might still be useable salvage, or at the very least useable shelter.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old collection of homes might once have housed the families of shipbuilders.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a faint path twisting through the thick woodland here. It is difficult to see very far ahead.
ctx: world map location description

en: The remains of this grand highroad are still in excellent condition. Visibility is very clear, but this could also be a detriment.
ctx: world map location description

en: There's a hut by the edge of a small pond here. It seems out of place in such a harsh stretch of terrain.
ctx: world map location description

en: It looks as though a shelter was built partway into an existing cave in the mountainside here.
ctx: world map location description

en: An almost palpable darkness hangs in a heavy cloud around the grounds of this old mansion. There is no sign of life or activity of any kind.
ctx: world map location description

en: This tower looks to have once been used for receiving and processing cargo by sea. It is built partway into the side of the cliff overlooking the water.
ctx: world map location description

en: A dark chasm. Who knows how far down it goes?
ctx: world map location description

en: An old guard post along the road. It appears to be in good shape, so it may still have supplies inside if you can find a way in.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old ferry station. The current is far too dangerous to attempt swimming, but you might be able to find some way to get the ferry working.
ctx: world map location description

en: This building looks to have been a roadside tavern once, possibly catering to sailors. Like everything else here, it is fallen into disrepair and overgrown.
ctx: world map location description

en: This road must have once been a major thoroughfare into the caldera. An old tolling station sits here, crumbling alongside the road.
ctx: world map location description

en: This section of the city appears to have been a sprawl of old workshops and storefronts. It seems unlikely that any of them will still be open for business.
ctx: world map location description

en: A lonely cliff overlooking the rocky coast below. There are a number of memorial tokens in the area, hinting at the area's history.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old courthouse has held up well over the years. It still retains an air of menacing authority.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old monastery, solemnly crumbling into a dignified pile of rubble.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old prison on a cliff overlooking the sea. It could make a decent shelter for the evening, but it is far too cramped to serve as a stronghold.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old one-room schoolhouse. It has held up surprisingly well. You can almost still hear the voices of schoolchildren singing.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old walled garden has been mostly overrun with weeds, but it might still make a decent camp, provided you don't mind an open sky overhead.
ctx: world map location description

en: This crumbling structure appears to be an ancient house of worship, but it seems long-abandoned.
ctx: world map location description

en: This old fortress is barely more than a shell, but it seems sturdy, and it is large enough to shelter a small army.
ctx: world map location description

en: A chill air flows from this place, and when you peek inside you are greeted with the sight of a temple formed of ice, worked and carved as if it were stone.
ctx: world map location description

en: This ancient barn-like structure is well-sheltered from the weather by surrounding terrain, and easily large enough to house dozens of people.
ctx: world map location description

en: This shrine has a lot of information about the basics of magic and combat effects.
ctx: world map location description

en: This shack is leaning to the left a little, but it seems otherwise sturdy. The terrain, however, is very rough, and the area wouldn't be suitable for use as a stronghold.
ctx: world map location description

en: This building looks like it used to be some kind of military outpost, but it's in shambles, and would be worthless as a stronghold. A nearby gatehouse might offer decent shelter for a night, at the very least.
ctx: world map location description

en: A footpath through a soggy marshland. You might be able to camp here short-term, but it is not large enough or safe enough for your whole band.
ctx: world map location description
